target_set_definition: Cases are grouped by the TYPE OF CLAIM (the `category` field: accuracy_claim, lift_claim, correlation_claim, eval_design_claim, synthetic_claim, reproducibility_claim, causal_claim, cost_claim, compliant). The target set is NEVER defined by whether the text contains a keyword. `expected_machine_checks` is a human judgement of which of the six deterministic checks a careful reviewer should raise, decided from what evidence the sentence actually supplies — not from what the current script happens to fire on. `compliant` cases are the reverse test: a sentence that supplies the evidence and must NOT be flagged.
label_source: Hand-written from recurring failure patterns in AI product docs; see references/failure-patterns.md. Paraphrased, no private or submission data.

cases.text: 模型准确率达到 94%，下周上线。
cases.note: No denominator, no way to re-run.

cases.text: 族识别精确率 100%，说明词表已经调好了。
cases.note: A perfect score usually means the target set was built from the thing being detected.

cases.text: 新版本让任务完成率从 62% 提升到 89%。
cases.note: No comparator named, causal verb, no denominator.

cases.text: 加了语境约束后，族识别准确率提升了 13.8 个百分点。
cases.note: Classic tuning-set gain; no hold-out, no other slice reported.

cases.text: 匹配分与实际回复的相关系数 r=0.62，证明匹配模型有效。
cases.note: No n or interval; a correlation used to assert the model works. The causal part is a semantic call the machine check cannot make.

cases.text: 上线后面试率提升了 13 个百分点，相关系数 r=0.62。
cases.note: Before/after with no control, plus an unexplained coefficient.

cases.text: 我们在 200 条样本上做了评测，准确率 93.6%。
cases.note: Denominator IS given (200 samples), so C01 must not fire. Still not reproducible.

cases.text: 示例数据里 10 条全部通过，效果稳定，可以直接对外引用。
cases.note: Undisclosed demo data about to migrate into an external claim.

cases.text: 演示报告中投递 60 家、面试率 21%，转化提升明显。
cases.note: Demo numbers quoted with no disclosure and no comparator.

cases.text: 实测英文数据集上族识别 93.6%，中文数据集 86.0%，与英文并列。
cases.note: Naming a dataset is not a reproduction pointer; no version, no script, no n.

cases.text: 新推荐策略带来面试率 2.6 倍增长。
cases.note: Causal verb, no control group.

cases.text: 人工标注 45 条真实 JD，族识别准确率 100%。
cases.note: Denominator IS present in natural Chinese wording ('45 条真实 JD'). A regex that misses it is a genuine false positive, and is scored as one.
Fraction form is a valid denominator; still no reproduction pointer.

cases.text: A/B 实验显示新模型让点击率提升 12%，p<0.05。
cases.note: A/B supplies the control and p<0.05 supplies uncertainty, so C05/C06 must NOT fire. The causal verb still needs hedging.

cases.text: 目标集取正文里含该能力词的记录，精确率 1.00（n=1838，脚本 scripts/x.py，版本 v1）。
cases.note: SEMANTIC-ONLY: every machine-visible piece of evidence is present, yet the measurement is circular. A regex pre-check cannot see this. This is the single most important case in the set.

cases.text: 以采集时的行业搜索词作标注，族识别准确率 44.4%（n=8674，复现脚本 scripts/y.py）。
cases.note: SEMANTIC-ONLY: the label column is a crawler search term, not an outcome.
SEMANTIC-ONLY: both numbers are well-formed; the problem is a mixed definition across reports.

cases.text: 同样预算下能多跑三倍请求。
cases.note: Chinese multiplier phrasing with no Arabic numeral. Labelled as a lift claim by a human; expected to be MISSED by the pre-check (a real false negative).

cases.text: 在 1,167 条 JD 的留出集上，规则引擎的岗位族识别准确率为 93.6%，n=1167，复现脚本 scripts/real_eval_family.py，数据版本 2026-10-28。
cases.note: REVERSE TEST: denominator, hold-out, script and version all stated.

cases.text: 在 2,000 条配对上，匹配分与实际回复的 Pearson r=0.193，n=2000，95% 置信区间 [-0.15, 0.21]，区间跨 0，因此不能认为两者相关。
cases.note: REVERSE TEST: interval reported and the conclusion is hedged correctly.

cases.text: 相比规则基线，blend 模式把任一命中率从 86.0% 提升到 93.4%，n=1000；增益在 dev 与留出集两边都出现，评测脚本 scripts/measure_split.py。
cases.note: REVERSE TEST: named baseline, denominator, both splits, reproduction script.

cases.text: 示例数据（编造，仅用于演示格式）里 10 条全部通过，为什么它好看：所有样例都由同一模板生成。
cases.note: REVERSE TEST: synthetic data explicitly disclosed and explained.

cases.text: 示例数据（编造，说明它为什么好看：模板生成）显示 10 条全通过，n=10，复现脚本 scripts/demo.py。
cases.note: REVERSE TEST: disclosure plus reproduction pointer.

cases.text: 相比上一版，A/B 实验里准确率从 86.0% 提升到 93.4%，n=1000，95% CI [1.2, 6.8]，脚本 scripts/ab.py，数据版本 2026-11-01。
cases.note: REVERSE TEST: baseline, control, denominator, interval, script, version.
